## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text combines [師會](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%B8%AB%E6%9C%83) Shīhuì's question-and-answer treatment of the *tóng jiào* doctrine with [善熹](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E7%86%B9) Shànxī's annotation. The work is part of the same Sòng Huáyán doctrinal-controversy literature on the *tóng jiào* / *bǐn jiào* distinction as *[Zhù huáyán tóng jiào yī chéng cè](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0135)* (X1016).

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1145 – 1180) reflects the period of [師會](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%B8%AB%E6%9C%83) Shīhuì and [善熹](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E7%86%B9) Shànxī's master-disciple collaborative scholarship. The work belongs to the same Sòng Huáyán *tóng jiào* / *bǐn jiào* literature as the parent *cè* and reflects the ongoing scholastic culture around mature Huáyán doctrinal categories.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1017) collection.
